description: HP-55 is the Registering & Licensing Authority (R&LA) located in Nadaun, Himachal Pradesh. It operates under the Hamirpur district administration and is responsible for vehicle registration, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations within the Nadaun sub-division.
